t006:
AT DUST IS
AN OLD WEIRDO.

I HEAR HE
MAKES SHADY
STUFF.

notes: With the immutable JOE name, the body reads “Scrap Joe at Dust is an old weirdo. I hear he makes shady stuff.” This preserves the Dust location, age, characterization, suspicious work, and hearsay within the source allocation. It omits the fuller waste-facility descriptor; recurring activity is phrased as a present-tense habit.
Natural greeting for the conditional alternative; opaque tail remains source-controlled.
